647	Because he saw that Yaakov was whole in everything, whole in his body, whole in his Torah, so he said: how can I damage his Torah?	Porque viu que Yaakov era íntegro em tudo, íntegro no corpo, íntegro na Torá, e disse: como prejudicar a Torá dele?
648	He struck the "supports of Torah" — the body corresponds to Tiferet, which is Torah, and the legs support the body, which are	Feriu os "sustentáculos da Torá" — o corpo corresponde a Tiferet, que é a Torá, e as pernas sustentam o corpo, que são

650	He upholds the Torah.	Ele sustenta a Torá.
651	"Let us strike them,	"Vamos feri-los,
652	so that they won't want to give tzedakah, won't want to donate, won't want this.	para que não queiram dar tzedaká, não queiram contribuir, não queiram isso.
653	That way we will bring down the world of Torah."	Assim derrubaremos o mundo da Torá."
654	So says the Zohar.	Assim diz o Zohar.
